blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — A third-class cadet at the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) was declared champion of a Korean-language speaking competition ahead of his joining the Republic of Korea Military Academy (ROKMA) in 2027, the military school announced on Wednesday, two months after the victory. Cadet Third Class Charlie Mark Eugenio Bumanglag, a member of PMA Class of 2029, will be attending ROKMA under the government’s Foreign Pre-Commission Training Institution (FPCTI) Program.
